quotes.text: Best experience in Myrtle Beach. Our large group of friends and family took the Pontiki Myrtle Beach cruise this evening. This completely exceeded all of our expectations.
Amazing evening!! Good way to start your vacation! We had 25 people on the boat and everyone had so much fun!! We are going to make this a yearly tradition!
Unmatched experience. EXCELLENT customer service. Trust me.. if you are planning on coming to Myrtle Beach, BOOK THIS THING. 10/5 STARS.
